archetype_description: Jewel & Luxury / Moody, intimate, cinematic. Adapted for a traditional Hyderabadi kitchen at dusk.

body.style: Clean, highly readable against dark backgrounds

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Dark, intimate, and moody. Avoid symmetrical perfection. Let the content breathe like the aroma of a slow-cooked meal.

grid_patterns.menu_staggered: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8 items-start. Middle column should have 'md:mt-12' to create a staggered, organic look rather than a rigid corporate grid.
grid_patterns.how_to_order: flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-8 justify-between items-start

hero.style: Full viewport height (min-h-screen). Background image with heavy dark overlay to ensure text contrast. Content aligned center or slightly offset. Huge serif typography.
hero.overlay: bg-[#1E0E05]/70 or bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1E0E05]/40 via-[#1E0E05]/60 to-[#1E0E05]

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4860B] text-[#1E0E05] hover:bg-[#E8A823] font-semibold px-8 py-3 rounded transition-colors
buttons.whatsapp_floating: fixed bottom-8 right-8 z-50 bg-[#D4860B] text-[#1E0E05] hover:bg-[#E8A823] p-4 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(212,134,11,0.3)] transition-transform hover:scale-110 flex items-center justify-center

badges.non_veg: bg-[#7A1E1E]/20 text-[#7A1E1E] border border-[#7A1E1E]/30 px-3 py-1 rounded text-xs uppercase tracking-widest
badges.veg: bg-[#4E7A3B]/20 text-[#4E7A3B] border border-[#4E7A3B]/30 px-3 py-1 rounded text-xs uppercase tracking-widest

hero_background.alt: Assorted Indian spices dark moody flatlay
hero_background.usage: Hero section background with heavy #1E0E05 overlay

pickle_jar_1.alt: Traditional Indian mango pickle in rustic jar
pickle_jar_1.usage: Featured image for veg pickles section or about section

spice_texture.usage: Background texture for How to Order or Contact sections (with extreme opacity reduction)

meal_shot.alt: South Indian meal on banana leaf
meal_shot.usage: Visual accent in the footer or story section

icons.strategy: Use sparingly. Must use the accent color (#D4860B) for active icons or text_muted (#C4A35A) for decorative icons. For the floating WhatsApp button, use the MessageCircle icon or import a custom SVG.

motion.strategy: Slow, deliberate, elegant. No bouncy animations.
motion.hover: Smooth color and slight transform transitions (duration-300).
motion.entrance: Fade in with a slight upward translation (framer-motion, y: 20, opacity: 0 to 1, duration 0.8, ease: easeOut).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #F2E4C4 is highly legible against #1E0E05 and #2C1507. If needed, apply text-shadow to headings over images.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings MUST use #D4860B with ring-offset-[#1E0E05].
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme. No white backgrounds, no gray-scale defaults. Use #1E0E05 for main backgrounds.
Use Playfair Display for all Headings (H1, H2, H3) and Work Sans for body text.
Implement the 'Staggered Card Layout' for the menu. Map over items, and conditionally add a top margin (e.g., 'mt-0 md:mt-12') to the middle column elements to break the grid.
For the Snacks Pricing Table, build a custom responsive HTML table using the divider color (#3A1E0A) for borders, not a generic Shadcn datatable.
The floating WhatsApp CTA must be fixed to the bottom right and remain visible at all times.
Inject 'lucide-react' icons where necessary, but maintain the traditional, handcrafted feel.
When applying the background image to the hero, ensure an overlay like 'bg-[#1E0E05]/70' is applied so the text is fully readable.
Form inputs must use the custom styling provided in the components.inputs section. Do not use default white Shadcn inputs.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and form inputs.
